_readme: Add new entries to the end of any list and push. Quotes need an isbn (10 or 13 digits) to link to Bookshop.org. Set bookshopAffiliateId to your own Bookshop.org affiliate number to earn commission on purchases (leave empty for plain links).

novelQuotes.text: Zóra was a woman of principle, an open atheist. At the age of thirteen, a priest had told her that animals had no souls, and she had said, 'Well then, fuck you, Pops,' and walked out of church.
novelQuotes.author: Téa Obreht

novelQuotes.text: Reality is frequently inaccurate.
novelQuotes.author: Douglas Adams
novelQuotes.book: The Restaurant at the End of the Universe

novelQuotes.text: 'We are going to gossip about you,' Mahasen would say to him, 'in little pieces.' The word for 'gossip' meant cutting, too.
novelQuotes.author: Leila Aboulela

novelQuotes.text: The ships hung in the sky in much the same way that bricks don't.
novelQuotes.author: Douglas Adams
novelQuotes.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy

novelQuotes.text: The sky above the port was the color of television, tuned to a dead channel.
novelQuotes.author: William Gibson

novelQuotes.text: So much had fallen into the sea. Hats fell in to the sea. Hearts fell into the sea. So much had fallen into the sea.
novelQuotes.author: Edwidge Danticat

novelQuotes.text: It could be verified that no princess was ever asked whether she wanted to be rescued and carried off by a dragon-slayer to a fate (no doubt) worse than death.
novelQuotes.author: Naomi Mitchison

novelQuotes.text: Let us wonder at how X was just a rare letter until algebra came along and made it something special that can be unravelled to reveal inner value.
novelQuotes.author: Bernardine Evaristo

novelQuotes.text: What she loved most about America, Eilis thought on these mornings, was how the heating was kept on all night.
novelQuotes.author: Colm Tóibín

novelQuotes.text: Still, there are times I am bewildered by each mile I have traveled, each meal I have eaten, each person I have known, each room in which I have slept. As ordinary as it all appears, there are times when it is beyond my imagination.
novelQuotes.author: Jhumpa Lahiri

novelQuotes.text: We were the people who were not in the papers. We lived in the blank white spaces at the edges of print.
novelQuotes.author: Margaret Atwood

novelQuotes.text: It's bad enough... when a country gets colonized, but when the people do as well! That's the end, really, that's the end.
novelQuotes.author: Tsitsi Dangarembga

novelQuotes.text: When a person undergoes such a drastic transformation, there's simply nothing anyone else can do but sit back and let them get on with it.
novelQuotes.author: Han Kang

novelQuotes.text: It's a poor sort of memory that only works backwards.
novelQuotes.author: Lewis Carroll

novelQuotes.text: It was a bright cold day in April, and the clocks were striking thirteen.
novelQuotes.author: George Orwell

novelQuotes.text: The snow in the mountains was melting and Bunny had been dead for several weeks before we came to understand the gravity of our situation.
novelQuotes.author: Donna Tartt

novelQuotes.text: It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife.
novelQuotes.author: Jane Austen

novelQuotes.text: Happy families are all alike; every unhappy family is unhappy in its own way.
novelQuotes.author: Leo Tolstoy

novelQuotes.text: Our father, the baron, was a dull man certainly, although not a bad one: dull because his life was dominated by thoughts that were out of step, as often happens in eras of transition.
novelQuotes.author: Italo Calvino

novelQuotes.text: Sophia asked her grandmother what Heaven looked like, and Grandmother said it might be like the pasture they were just then walking by, on their way to the village over on the mainland. They stopped to look.
novelQuotes.author: Tove Jansson

novelQuotes.text: When my hands are restless and I need to stim, I now imagine that they contain magic. That the twitchy feeling is just like fire trying to get out.
novelQuotes.author: Elle McNicoll

novelQuotes.text:
While Vondie and JB
debate whether the new girl
is a knockout or just beautiful,
a hottie or a cutie,
a lay-up or a dunk,
I finish my vocabulary homework—
and my brother's vocabulary homework,
which I don't mind
since English is my favorite subject
and he did the dishes for me last week.
novelQuotes.author: Kwame Alexander

novelQuotes.text: I think I've been able to run for more than twenty years for a simple reason: It suits me. Or at least because I don't find it all that painful.
novelQuotes.author: Haruki Murakami
novelQuotes.book: What I Talk About When I Talk About Running

novelQuotes.text: 'Say something!' she demanded, threatening to tear out our tongues. Little did she know that one of us was holding her tongue in her hand.
novelQuotes.author: Itamar Vieira Junior

novelQuotes.text: In the Hardenbergs' house there was an angel, August Wilhelm Bernhard, fair as wheat. After plain motherly Charlotte, the eldest, pale, wide-eyed Fritz, stumpy little Erasmus, easy-going Karl, open-hearted Sidonie, painstaking Anton, came the blonde Bernhard.
novelQuotes.author: Penelope Fitzgerald

novelQuotes.text: Then, beyond her face reflected back to her, deeper within the pool, she saw a cluster of oysters bunched white in the shadow. It was almost too much to imagine putting her arm back into the cold, but she did, swearing.
novelQuotes.author: Lauren Groff

novelQuotes.text: A son will always be a son, they say. But a girl is like a goat. Good as long as she gives you milk and butter. But not worth crying over when it's time to make a stew.
novelQuotes.author: Patricia McCormick

craftQuotes.text: I want to put a group of characters (perhaps a pair; perhaps even just one) in some sort of predicament and then watch them try to work themselves free.
craftQuotes.author: Stephen King
craftQuotes.book: On Writing: A Memoir of the Craft

craftQuotes.text: Once you try your hand at it, you soon find that [writing] isn't as peaceful a job as it seems. The whole process—sitting at your desk, focusing your mind like a laser beam, imagining something out of a blank horizon, creating a story, selecting the right words, one by one, keeping the whole flow of the story on track—requires far more energy, over a long period, than most people ever imagine. You might not move your body around, but there's a grueling, dynamic labor going on inside you.
craftQuotes.author: Haruki Murakami
craftQuotes.book: What I Talk About When I Talk About Running: A Memoir

craftQuotes.text: We always worry that we are copying someone else, that we don't have our own style. Don't worry. Writing is a communal act. Contrary to popular belief, a writer is not Prometheus alone on a hill full of fire.
craftQuotes.author: Natalie Goldberg
craftQuotes.book: Writing Down the Bones: Freeing the Writer Within

craftQuotes.text:
You and your younger brother are competing for leadership of the Labour Party; you are far more experienced and everyone expects you to win. How do you feel if you lose? What do you say to him?

The conflict between how we wish to be perceived and what we really feel is at the root of all character.
craftQuotes.author: John Yorke
craftQuotes.book: Into the Woods: How Stories Work and Why We Tell Them

craftQuotes.text: A pro views her work as craft, not art. Not because she believes art is devoid of a mystical dimension. On the contrary. She understands that all creative endeavor is holy, but she doesn't dwell on it. She knows if she thinks about that too much, it will paralyze her.
craftQuotes.author: Steven Pressfield
craftQuotes.book: The War of Art: Break Through the Blocks and Win Your Inner Creative Battles

craftQuotes.text: Research must not become procrastination…Research is meat to feed the beasts of imagination and invention, never an end in itself.
craftQuotes.author: Robert McKee
craftQuotes.book: Story: Substance, Structure, Style, and the Principles of Screenwriting
